title: Minuta 2025-02-06
summary: The minutes of the 6 February decision document a 50bp cut to 9.50% approved 4-1, framed as a recalibration of a still-clearly-restrictive stance (real ex-ante rate above 6% and above neutral) rather than the start of a rush toward neutrality. Forward guidance repeats that the Board could keep calibrating and consider a similar-magnitude adjustment while keeping policy restrictive, so the easing bias is intact. Relative to the communique, the minutes read a touch less dovish: they reveal a more divided Board - Jonathan Heath dissented for a smaller 25bp cut arguing there are severe doubts about the continuation of disinflation and that the pace should not be increased, and another member emphatically ruled out a cycle of 50bp cuts to neutrality - alongside repeated insistence on preserving a restrictive stance and the 3% credibility. The dovish case rests on notable disinflation progress (headline 3.69%, core 3.72% back near its pre-pandemic average), a Q4 GDP contraction and a decelerating labor market, while US tariff threats, peso depreciation risk and minimum-wage/cost pressures are the main two-sided risks.

key_quotes.quote: decidió por mayoría reducir en 50 puntos base el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día a un nivel de 9.50%.
key_quotes.context: Decisão da reunião: corte de 50bp por maioria, com dissidência

key_quotes.quote: La Junta de Gobierno estima que hacia delante podría continuar con la calibración de la postura monetaria y considerar ajustarla en magnitud similar.
key_quotes.context: Guidance mantendo viés de novos cortes de magnitude similar

key_quotes.quote: no prevé un ciclo de recortes de esa magnitud que lleve la tasa a un nivel de neutralidad próximamente.
key_quotes.context: Membro ressalva enfaticamente que 50bp não é o ritmo padrão rumo à neutralidade — minuta menos dovish que o comunicado

key_quotes.quote: Prevé que el entorno inflacionario permita seguir con el ciclo de recortes a la tasa de referencia, si bien manteniendo una postura restrictiva.
key_quotes.context: Ciclo de cortes segue, mas insistência na postura restritiva
